# Represent Commercial

> Represent Commercial helps established businesses in Brisbane and South East Queensland renew, relocate or buy the premises they operate from: commercial property representation for business occupiers, with particular relevance to industrial and warehouse occupiers. Principal-led. When appointed on a tenancy it acts for the tenant; when appointed on a purchase it acts for the buyer, never the vendor or landlord. Office, retail and industrial premises. Led by Nick O'Toole, Founder and Director, with 20+ years of owner-side commercial property experience. Real Estate Agent Licence 4949809.

## Primary focus
Represent Commercial advises established businesses deciding whether to renew, relocate or buy their premises.

## Additional services
Represent Commercial also provides selected investors and property owners with buyer-side acquisition, property management, commercial leasing and asset management services. Represent Commercial acts exclusively for the appointed client in each matter and does not represent both sides of the same negotiation.

## Brand
- Master brand: Exclusively on your side of the table.

## Services
1. Commercial Tenant Representation: tenant-side representation for businesses renewing a lease or relocating, for industrial, office and retail occupiers in Brisbane and throughout Queensland
2. Buyer's Agency for Business Premises: independent buyer representation for businesses buying the premises they will occupy, including through an SMSF, across Brisbane, South East Queensland and regional Queensland, never acting for the vendor

Additional services for investors and property owners:
3. Investment Buyer's Agency: buyer-side representation for commercial property investors
4. Commercial Property Management: owner-side management of commercial property
5. Commercial Leasing: owner-side leasing of commercial property
6. Commercial Asset Management: owner-side strategic oversight of commercial property
